answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 151 Country: United Kingdom Title: Are you allowed to put a gravestone on a grave? Question: Are you allowed to put a gravestone on a grave? Answer ID: 151 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 378/J) To put a gravestone on a grave is allowed for identification purpose, but it should have only the name of the dead, not any Quranic verse: اخرج ابوداؤد (في سننہ ص 457 باب جمع الموتی قبر والقبر یعلم ، من ابواب الجنائز) باسناد جید ان رسول اللہ صلی اللہ وعلیہ وسلم حمل حجراً فوضعھا عند راس عثمان بن مظعون وقال اتعلم بھا قبر اخي و ادفن الیہ من مات من اھلي۔ (رد المحتار، 3/144 ، ط زکریا، دیوبند) And, if there is no need for identification then one should not put a gravestone. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
